text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Panel composition alone proves nothing. Newsroom and HR panels are often skewed one way or another, and an all-women panel is as consistent with chance or departmental makeup as with bias. If you raise it, you shift the conversation from your case to your suspicions — and you look like a man explaining a loss by the selectors' sex. That rarely ends well, even when a grievance is otherwise sound.

The real signal is elsewhere: "strong experience of digital media" against your longer but possibly more traditional record is a plausible, legitimate reason to prefer her.

Chase the written explanation — politely, in writing, copying HR. If the reasons given are incoherent or shift, reassess then.
